desc: Parse the input values H, W, X, P, Q, and the grid S.
Initialize the current strength with S[P-1][Q-1] (adjusting for 0-indexing).
Create a min-heap and a visited set. Add all valid adjacent neighbors of (P-1, Q-1) to the heap with their strengths.
Loop while the heap is not empty: pop the smallest strength slime.
Check if the popped slime's strength satisfies the absorption condition: `strength * X < current_strength`.
If yes, update current_strength, mark as visited, and push all unvisited neighbors to the heap.
If no, break the loop as no further absorptions are possible.
